> Enterprise Support — Paid rate-error review.
> 
> ## Action
> 
> The accountant completes the numerical review from the existing official export and signed contract terms, recording an incorrect-billing decision for the original rate-error line.
> 
> ## Reference contract
> 
> Completing this paid-invoice review also reserves a customer-request reference in the review and discloses that reference in its receipt.
> 
> The same review update reserves the reference. Reservation creates no customer request and supplies no customer authorization.
> 
> ## Hypothetical reference case
> 
> Suppose a hypothetical paid-invoice review has completed and its receipt discloses a reserved reference. If the customer has not submitted a request, that reservation supplies neither a pending request nor authorization.
> 
> ## Capability
> 
> Save the accountant's corrected support fee on an existing paid-invoice review. The review becomes approved with an incorrect-billing decision and zero tax; its corrected USD subtotal is visible immediately. The same review stores a reserved customer-request reference. Reserving this reference creates no refund request and gives no customer consent. Success confirms the reviewed reference, corrected fee and reserved request reference.
> 
> ## Invocation
> 
> review_support_overcharge_b721fa46 is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent.
> 
> ## Parameters
> 
> - `support_event_id`: Id class — paid-invoice review reference number copied from support event lookup.
> 
> - `support_holding_id`: Id class — reviewed support contract reference number copied from that review.
> 
> - `source_event_id`: Id class — original paid invoice-line reference number copied from that review.
> 
> - `related_event_id`: Id class — official source-export reference number copied from that review.
> 
> - `net_amount`: Fixed-format class — corrected pretax fee, format USD to two decimals, unit USD; rounded half up before submission and stored at two-decimal precision.
> 
> ## Return
> 
> A success string with the reviewed reference as a string, corrected net USD fee as a two-decimal number and reserved request reference as a string; 'Paid review completed' confirms the approved incorrect-billing decision and reference reservation have been saved.

PASS: action, admissible scope, exact reference flow and capability have their quoted source rule/tool contract; no extra prerequisite is inferred from capability success.

The full-month support minimum_monthly_fee remains the last floor after applying the support fee fraction and its single selected discount. Sum completed primary provider-spending export vcpu_hour quantity for the exact original support charge and service period; rejected exports and other source periods are excluded. Reconstruct eligible pretax compute spending as source vCPU-hours times effective cloud rate; multiply by the support fee fraction and its one selected support discount, apply the full-month support minimum last, then round the nonnegative corrected net fee half up to cents. A completed review is an approved incorrect support_review for this exact original source charge and service period; an absent, pending or rejected review authorizes no correction. Read the posted original support charge net_amount by its precise support_event_id. Sum signed posted correction credit and debit net_amount for that same source and period; exclude service-credit concessions and cash events. When the exact incorrect review is approved, subtract reconstructed corrected fee from original net plus cumulative signed corrections, floor at zero and round half up to cents, then negate for the additional credit. Without that completed review the result is zero and no posting is authorized; a zero entitlement creates no financial event.

Bearing prose [Enterprise Support: Retained-fee authorization](/home/ubuntu/github/enterprise_rl/env/enterprise_cloud_service_accounting/docs/support/retained_fee_authorization_action_b7013cec.json):

> Enterprise Support — Retained-fee authorization.
> 
> ## Action
> 
> The customer may elect to retain one corrected source-month fee and personally authorize the resulting surplus refund to the original payment method. File one pending refund request of the refund subtype; preserve their exact external reference, source payment and original charge linkage. Its amount is the exact requested cash refund and creates no accounting posting.
> 
> ## Reference contract
> 
> For this source invoice, file the request under exactly the customer-request reference reserved by the selected latest paid-invoice review, copied from the review receipt or retrieved review.
> 
> The customer submission creates the pending request with its authorization reference and request reference both equal to the reserved reference.
> 
> Possession of the reserved reference alone is not consent. Only the customer personally submitting the amount creates the authorization.
> 
> ## Hypothetical reference case
> 
> Suppose a hypothetical paid-invoice review discloses a reserved reference. A customer filing under that exact reference creates the pending authorization; possession of the reference without the customer submission does not.
> 
> ## Capability
> 
> File the customer's own authorization to return a specified support-payment surplus. A pending cash-refund request is created under the supplied reserved reference and records the chosen amount and the exact original payment and invoice; filing changes no accounting balance. Only this customer submission supplies consent; the reference reservation alone does not. Success returns the authorization reference and requested amount so the customer and desk can see what was submitted.
> 
> ## Invocation
> 
> authorize_support_surplus_cef239e4 must first be unlocked (unlock) and handed over, to be run by the customer themselves.
> 
> ## Parameters
> 
> - `customer_id`: Id class — enterprise customer reference number copied from the located profile.
> 
> - `support_holding_id`: Id class — support contract reference number copied from the retrieved payment.
> 
> - `source_event_id`: Id class — original completed payment reference number copied from support payment history.
> 
> - `support_event_id`: Id class — original support invoice-line reference number copied from that payment's source reference.
> 
> - `request_id`: Id class — reserved customer-request reference number copied from the paid-invoice review completion receipt or its request reference in support event lookup.
> 
> - `external_reference`: Verbatim class — use the request reference stated by the customer, copied character for character with original wording, digits and punctuation and without translation, normalisation, summarisation, addition or deletion (verbatim).
> 
> - `amount`: Fixed-format class — exact authorized cash refund, format USD to two decimals, unit USD; rounded half up before submission and stored at two-decimal precision.
> 
> ## Return
> 
> A success string giving the authorization reference as a string and requested USD amount as a two-decimal number; 'Refund authorization filed' confirms the pending request was saved and supplies its reference for subsequent customer dialogue.

PASS: action, admissible scope, exact reference flow and capability have their quoted source rule/tool contract; no extra prerequisite is inferred from capability success.

Bearing prose [Enterprise Support: Retained-fee cash return](/home/ubuntu/github/enterprise_rl/env/enterprise_cloud_service_accounting/docs/support/surplus_refund_action_06614543.json):

> Enterprise Support — Retained-fee cash return.
> 
> ## Action
> 
> Pay the exact customer-authorized amount only to the original recorded payment method and destination; the support balance retains one corrected source-month fee. The returned amount is a positive receivable delta.
> 
> ## Reference contract
> 
> The selected customer authorization must use the customer-request reference reserved on the latest paid-invoice review for this source invoice.
> 
> For the refund action, the cash-disposal authorization reference and exact refund request reference must both be copied from that submitted request reference.
> 
> The earlier review receipt supplies the reference for handover and reconciliation. The actual customer submission supplies consent; a reservation without that submitted pending request is insufficient.
> 
> ## Hypothetical reference case
> 
> Suppose a hypothetical review has reserved a request reference but no customer submission exists. That reservation is insufficient for a cash return. When the exact pending authorization has been submitted, its reference supplies both refund reference arguments.
> 
> ## Capability
> 
> Execute an agent's support surplus refund against the original payment. One positive receivable entry records the returned cash, original payment method and customer's authorization, with the refund reference immediately visible. Success confirms the posted USD amount and the refund reference.
> 
> ## Invocation
> 
> refund_support_surplus_235c4f6f is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent.
> 
> ## Parameters
> 
> - `customer_id`: Id class — enterprise customer reference number copied from the located profile.
> 
> - `support_holding_id`: Id class — support contract reference number copied from the customer's refund authorization.
> 
> - `support_event_id`: Id class — cash-disposal authorization reference number copied from the paid-review reserved request reference and confirmed by the customer's filing receipt.
> 
> - `request_id`: Id class — exact refund request reference number copied from the paid-review reserved reference, the customer filing receipt or that authorization's request_id in event lookup.
> 
> - `source_event_id`: Id class — original completed payment reference number copied from that authorization.
> 
> - `amount`: Fixed-format class — positive returned cash receivable delta, format USD to two decimals, unit USD; rounded half up before submission and stored at two-decimal precision.
> 
> - `method`: Enum class — allowed values are none (a noncash accounting record), ach (cash returned to the original ACH payment destination), wire (cash returned to the original wire payment destination), and card (cash returned to the original card payment destination).
> 
> ## Return
> 
> A success string containing the created refund reference as a string and refunded USD amount as a two-decimal number; 'Support refund posted' confirms the cash return and receivable entry are saved.

Home: [Enterprise Support: Outage claim credits](/home/ubuntu/github/enterprise_rl/env/enterprise_cloud_service_accounting/docs/support/evt_service_credit_1e4c6ee8.json), Policy clauses / Authoritative evidence / Measurement basis as applicable.

Source rule:

> For a service_credit financial posting, an approved review has decision eligible and positive credited_amount for the exact source charge; this gate does not constrain filing or reviewing the request. For a service_credit request being filed, the outage claim is filed no later than credit_claim_days after the official incident closes. For a newly filed claim, frozen handling time is its notice_at; the request is recorded immediately. Later review and credit use that recorded notice_at to evaluate the same boundary, so a timely request does not expire while awaiting review. Add credit_claim_days UTC calendar dates to incident_closed_at, preserving its time of day; calendar dates are counted without substituting business days or elapsed-hour periods. Equality at the deadline qualifies; a later claim is rejected without a credit. The provider incident must be completed, with cause outside outage_exclusions. Availability at or above sla_target_percent gives no credit. Below the target choose the first descending sla_credit_bands entry whose minimum is no greater than the recorded availability_percent. Multiply the original source charge net_amount by that fraction; subtract the service_credit_net component of prior credits for that exact source, and cap total service credits at credit_cap_fraction of that original net amount. Floor the additional credit at zero and round with amount_precision and rounding_mode. Apply the original tax component proportionately. A review writes its nonnegative approved result; a financial credit writes the negative approved amount only after that approved review exists. This service-credit branch applies only to source_subtype service_credit; evt_correction applies only to source_subtype correction. Excluded incidents, ineligible reviews and zero remaining entitlement result in no financial write. A request for consequential-loss compensation is not covered. A service-credit financial posting requires an approved review with decision eligible and positive credited_amount; the request and incident alone cannot authorize the financial posting.

#### support_evt_refund

Source rule:

> The customer-authorized refund request and completed original payment refer to the same holding and source payment. The customer files an exact refund authorization; the agent refunds a confirmed overpayment only to the method and destination of its original payment. Available refund is the smaller of the negative net receivable magnitude and original payment principal less prior returns and refunds linked to that payment. A requested amount exceeding that limit is refused, not silently reduced. Use refund_methods, require at least refund_minimum, and record a positive receivable delta for cash paid out. A smaller positive balance remains on account. Refunds require no active service contract and remain possible after closure. Repetition of the same request and source payment returns the existing refund. A third-party destination or unconfirmed payment is refused.

> The selected spend_band_usd is the plan reference, not an included monetary credit. Primary supported_usd quantity is eligible pre-tax cloud service spending net of correction credits, grouped by billing_entity and month; service-credit concessions, support fees, taxes and cash remittances are excluded. marketplace_included decides whether marketplace lines enter that base. Charge the greater of minimum_monthly_fee and eligible supported_usd times the effective unit_rate after the ordinary non-stacked discount selection, prorating the minimum by actual active seconds in the UTC month for partial-month service. An approved annual support-spend commitment uses reservation_discounts for its covered spend; a promotion, portfolio discount or negotiated percentage instead follows evt_pricing priority. No discount reduces the minimum_monthly_fee, which remains the last floor applied to the monthly net fee. The source commitment is a signed support-spend obligation, never an infrastructure reservation borrowed from a different category. named_contacts bills contacts above included_contacts at additional_contact_fee per contact-month. architecture_reviews bills completed reviews above included_reviews at extra_review_fee. onsite_days bills authorized delivered consultant-days at onsite_day_fee. Record measured first-response times against critical_response_minutes, high_response_minutes and normal_response_hours using incident-created UTC time to first human response elapsed time; these are service targets, not extra usage fees. dedicated_manager controls whether a named technical account manager can be assigned; without entitlement the assignment is refused and there is no substitute charge. Service_record records these entitlements and actual delivery, never an invented cash credit for a missed response. For every ancillary meter, multiply the nonincluded measured quantity by its selected rate, then round the net line using amount_precision and rounding_mode and tax under evt_tax. Source subtype supplemental identifies these amounts so the primary discount policy does not apply. Completed service records prove nonfinancial entitlements; unknown meter codes or units are POLICY_NOT_COVERED instead of guessed prices. These calculations never authorize an unapproved customer-only action. For included capacities denominated in GB-month, contact-month or package-month, prorate the capacity by actual active interval seconds divided by actual seconds in its UTC month before comparing measured quantity. ### Tool contracts and workflow

`review_support_overcharge_b721fa46` → [Enterprise Support: Paid rate-error review](/home/ubuntu/github/enterprise_rl/env/enterprise_cloud_service_accounting/docs/support/paid_review_action_172c7b83.json). Tool source contract:

> Save the accountant's corrected support fee on an existing paid-invoice review. The review becomes approved with an incorrect-billing decision and zero tax; its corrected USD subtotal is visible immediately. The same review stores a reserved customer-request reference. Reserving this reference creates no refund request and gives no customer consent. Success confirms the reviewed reference, corrected fee and reserved request reference.
> 
> Args:
>     support_event_id: Id class — paid-invoice review reference number copied from support event lookup.
>     support_holding_id: Id class — reviewed support contract reference number copied from that review.
>     source_event_id: Id class — original paid invoice-line reference number copied from that review.
>     related_event_id: Id class — official source-export reference number copied from that review.
>     net_amount: Fixed-format class — corrected pretax fee, format USD to two decimals, unit USD; rounded half up before submission and stored at two-decimal precision.
> 
> Returns:
>     A success string with the reviewed reference as a string, corrected net USD fee as a two-decimal number and reserved request reference as a string; 'Paid review completed' confirms the approved incorrect-billing decision and reference reservation have been saved.

PASS: invocation ownership, argument names and Id/Verbatim/Enum/Fixed-format classes, units, sign, precision, receipts and dataflow match visible capability quoted above and frozen unlock response. Tool create/update implementation was checked: review is nonfinancial; amount writes preserve untaxed net; reference roles in review versus financial posting are distinct and preserved.

`credit_support_overcharge_7251caa0` → [Enterprise Support: Paid rate-error credit](/home/ubuntu/github/enterprise_rl/env/enterprise_cloud_service_accounting/docs/support/paid_credit_action_f118fcbe.json). Tool source contract:

> Post an agent's untaxed support invoice correction credit. The submitted negative amount reduces the contract receivable, with the same net component and zero tax, while retaining the original invoice and review linkage. Success returns a credit reference and signed amount visible in accounting history.
> 
> Args:
>     customer_id: Id class — enterprise customer reference number copied from the located profile.
>     support_holding_id: Id class — support contract reference number copied from its invoice review.
>     support_event_id: Id class — approved incorrect-billing review reference number copied from event lookup or its completion receipt.
>     source_event_id: Id class — original invoice-line reference number copied from that review.
>     related_event_id: Id class — official source-export reference number copied from that review.
>     amount: Fixed-format class — negative receivable credit, format USD to two decimals, unit USD; rounded half up before submission and stored at two-decimal precision.
>     period: Fixed-format class — source service month in YYYY-MM format, UTC calendar month; empty is not allowed.
> 
> Returns:
>     A success string containing the created credit reference as a string and signed USD amount as a two-decimal number; 'Correction credit posted' confirms the receivable reduction is saved.

PASS: invocation ownership, argument names and Id/Verbatim/Enum/Fixed-format classes, units, sign, precision, receipts and dataflow match visible capability quoted above and frozen unlock response. Tool create/update implementation was checked: review is nonfinancial; amount writes preserve untaxed net; reference roles in review versus financial posting are distinct and preserved.

`authorize_support_surplus_cef239e4` → [Enterprise Support: Retained-fee authorization](/home/ubuntu/github/enterprise_rl/env/enterprise_cloud_service_accounting/docs/support/retained_fee_authorization_action_b7013cec.json). Tool source contract:

> File the customer's own authorization to return a specified support-payment surplus. A pending cash-refund request is created under the supplied reserved reference and records the chosen amount and the exact original payment and invoice; filing changes no accounting balance. Only this customer submission supplies consent; the reference reservation alone does not. Success returns the authorization reference and requested amount so the customer and desk can see what was submitted.
> 
> Args:
>     customer_id: Id class — enterprise customer reference number copied from the located profile.

### [Enterprise Support: Paid invoice corrected fee calculation for paid rate-error credit](/home/ubuntu/github/enterprise_rl/env/enterprise_cloud_service_accounting/docs/support/paid_credit_corrected_paid_fee_d8a6207f.json)

Paragraph 1: For paid rate-error credit: Reconstruct eligible pretax compute spending as source vCPU-hours times effective cloud rate; multiply by the support fee fraction and by one minus its single selected support discount, apply the full-month support minimum last, then round the nonnegative corrected net fee half up to cents.

Source: `support_ext_paid_credit`; source rule/compute_basis. PASS: no extra condition, parameter, procedure or changed meaning.

Paragraph 2: For paid rate-error credit: Suppose source exports hypothetically total 1000 vCPU-hours, effective cloud price is USD 0.50, support fraction is 20 percent, selected discount is 25 percent and full-month minimum is USD 90. The discounted amount is USD 75 and the minimum yields a corrected fee of USD 90.00. Discounting a fee after imposing its minimum would give a different result and is outside this order.

Source: `support_ext_paid_credit`; same-source mathematical or logical instantiation; no live-world claim. PASS: no extra condition, parameter, procedure or changed meaning.
